data.body: [P2] Allow valid replay segments for the observation step. This selector implicitly requires exactly one operation span, and its expectation pins that span to Invocation 2. However, the scenario revisits the completed observation step in Invocations 3 and 4, and case 21 explicitly permits invocation-view completed-step replay segments without rerunning the user attempt. An SDK following that permitted behavior therefore fails case 25 on the collector backend. Add count-dependent parent/link expectations for those replay segments while retaining exactly one observation attempt, and cover that trace shape in the regression tests.
